title: Overview: Portable Laser Scanners
description: Handheld laser scanners capturing 3D models of rooms, objects, and sites in minutes. The interface is where humans meet the digital world: better displays, audio, and input make technology disappear into everyday life. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: The working vocabulary of Portable Laser Scanners: Latency, Field of view, Haptics, Eyebox, Foveated rendering, SAR, Pairing, Firmware. The interface is where humans meet the digital world: better displays, audio, and input make technology disappear into everyday life.
definition: Glossary for Portable Laser Scanners.
key_points: Latency: Delay between action and response — under 20 ms feels instant.
Field of view: How wide the display image appears to the user.
Haptics: Touch feedback: vibration, force, or texture simulation.
Eyebox: The region where the eye sees the full display image.
Foveated rendering: Rendering full detail only where the eye looks.
SAR: Specific absorption rate — regulated RF exposure limit.
Pairing: Connecting a device to a phone or computer wirelessly.
Firmware: Low-level software controlling the device hardware.

Use the demo as a flash drill.
